channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kenny Atkinson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kenny Atkinson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Kenny Atkinson
item.description:
Pacers head coach Rick Carlisle on Kenny Atkinson’s rant:

“He’s protecting his players. That’s a part of a coach’s job… Nobody wants players hurt. That disappoints the hell out of *us*… I understand where he’s coming from completely.”

Rick Carlisle on Kenny Atkinson, May 6, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Koby Altman on Kenny Atkinson
item.description:
“We conducted a thorough and extensive search in the selecting of the next head coach of the Cleveland Cavaliers and today, we are excited to welcome Kenny Atkinson to Northeast Ohio,”

Koby Altman on Kenny Atkinson, Jun 28, 2024. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Bob Myers on Kenny Atkinson
item.description:
Mark Medina:Bob Myers on Kenny Atkinson staying on the Warriors' coaching staff after changing his mind about the Hornets staff:

“Kenny is a great coach. As long as we can keep him, he'll help us.”

Bob Myers on Kenny Atkinson, Jun 22, 2022. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Andrew Wiggins on Kenny Atkinson
item.description:
CJ Holmes:Andrew Wiggins on Kenny Atkinson's return:

“He gave up a head coaching job to come back and be a part of this thing we got here. It's amazing. It shows that all we got here is a bunch of people that want to win, that are on the same page. And we're looking forward to the future.”

Andrew Wiggins on Kenny Atkinson, Jun 18, 2022. Source: Twitter @CjHolmes22.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Kenny Atkinson
item.description:
Rick Carlisle on Kenny Atkinson’s departure from the Nets:

“It caught a lot of people by surprise. I found out more about it yesterday, and it looks like it’s going to be a really great situation for him that he’s able to step away. He’ll have great options again next year.”

Rick Carlisle on Kenny Atkinson, Mar 8, 2020. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Kenny Atkinson
item.description:
Houston Rockets coachMike D'Antoni on Brooklyn Nets coach Kenny Atkinson losing his job:

“The only thing he's done there in the last two years, for sure, is overachieve. I don't know what else he could have done.”

Mike D'Antoni on Kenny Atkinson, Mar 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @rick_bonnell.

item.title: D'Angelo Russell on Kenny Atkinson
item.description:
D'Angelo Russell on Kenny Atkinson:

“The growth in relationships, genuine relationships, it’s a beautiful thing... I take pride in creating genuine relationships with people that genuinely care about you. And coach is one of the most genuine, emotional, man he’s a great dude.”

D'Angelo Russell on Kenny Atkinson, Apr 24, 2019. Source: Twitter @APOOCH.

item.title: D'Angelo Russell on Kenny Atkinson
item.description:
D'Angelo Russell on Kenny Atkinson:

“You've got a coach like Kenny, he's a working guy. Him and the coaches work their tail off. As a player you're a resemblance of your coach. We're a working team and that'll be in our favor this season.”

D'Angelo Russell on Kenny Atkinson, Feb 15, 2019. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: D'Angelo Russell on Kenny Atkinson
item.description:
D’Angelo Russell on finding out he’d made his 1st #NBAAllStar game:

“(Kenny Atkinson) was the first one to break it to me. I was in awe on the plane. I'm a crier, honestly. I was holding my tears in.”

D'Angelo Russell on Kenny Atkinson, Feb 1, 2019. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jeremy Lin on Kenny Atkinson
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Jeremy Lin on his conversation w/ Atkinson after being traded from #Nets:

“There wasn’t really much to say. Obviously I talked with him the morning after. But for me I’ll be honest I was really hurt. And maybe the way that things had happened was a little bit unexpected”

Jeremy Lin on Kenny Atkinson, Dec 16, 2018. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Joe Harris on Sean Marks, Kenny Atkinson
item.description:
Joe Harris said,

“We're trying to be as involved in the Brooklyn community as possible. That's been a focal point from the moment that Sean Marks and Kenny Atkinson got here.”

Joe Harris on Sean Marks, Kenny Atkinson, Oct 6, 2018. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Brett Brown on Kenny Atkinson
item.description:
76ers coach Brett Brown, who went 75-253 (.229) in the four previous seasons combined, understands what Kenny Atkinson is going through as the coach of a team in the midst of a long-term rebuilding phase.

“What I see is that he’s [Kenny Atkinson] really good at what they’re doing,”

Brett Brown on Kenny Atkinson, Mar 12, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Kenny Atkinson
item.description:
Marc Berman:Mike D’Antoni on Kenny Atkinson:

“He deserves it. He worked hard, knows his job & I think he'll do terrific job if you guys leave him alone.”

Mike D'Antoni on Kenny Atkinson, Oct 4, 2016. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Berman.

item.title: Big Sean on Kenny Atkinson
item.description:
“We are thrilled to announce Kenny Atkinson as our new head coach and to welcome him and his family to Brooklyn. Kenny’s years of NBA coaching experience working under successful head coaches such as Mike Budenholzer and Mike D’Antoni have provided him with the foundation and experience we were looking for in a head coach. We believe that Kenny’s core principles, leadership,communication skills and exceptional background in player development make him an ideal fit for the culture we are building in Brooklyn,”

Big Sean on Kenny Atkinson, Apr 17, 2016. Source: NBA.com.
